source_features.name: 力：点载荷 (pfx, pfy, pfz)
source_features.commands: stressdata bc.location=pointend point.coord={0 0 0} bc.value={pfx=0 pfy=0 \ pfz=@p@<dyn>}

source_features.name: 力：指定点的迪利克雷边界条件 (pdx, pdy, pdz)
source_features.commands: stressdata bc.location=<c> bc.value={pdx=<n> pdy=<n> pdz=<n>} point.coord={<n> <n> <n>}

source_features.name: 力：指定面的迪利克雷边界条件 (dx, dy, dz)
力：压力 (pressure)
source_features.reference: p.111 Pressure Boundary Condition; p.694 stressdata

source_features.name: 力：迪利克雷边界条件支持消行消列
热：Bottom Boundary Condition
source_features.commands:
pdbSet <material> AttachThermalResistor 1
pdbSet WaferThickness <n>
pdbSet Env.Temp <n>

source_features.name: 热：温度边界条件
source_features.reference: p.709 supply — Specifies a constant temperature supply.

source_features.name: 电：voltage
source_features.reference: p.709 supply — Specifies a constant voltage supply.

source_features.name: 边界条件/载荷支持 bc.location=<contact name>
力：塑性（各向同性、随动硬化）
力：绝对热膨胀系数与相对热膨胀系数切换
source_features.commands:
pdbSetDouble Mechanics RefThExpCoeff 0
or
pdbSetDouble Mechanics RefThExpCoeff <n>

source_features.name: 热：比热容、热导率、密度
source_features.commands:
pdbSet <material> MassDensity <n>
pdbSet <material> SpecificHeatCapacity <expression>
pdbSet <material> Temperature Conductivity <expression>

source_features.name: 力：粘弹性
source_features.commands:
pdbSetDouble Pass Mechanics Viscosity0 1e40
pdbSetDouble Pass Mechanics ViscosityW 0.0

source_features.name: 电：电导率
source_features.reference: p.17? Thermal Analysis（页码被指针遮挡）

source_features.name: 基于 new.like 继承并创建新材料
力：收敛判据日志打印开关
力：牛顿迭代参数设置
source_features.commands:
pdbSet Mechanics MaxIterations 20
pdbSet Mechanics Convergence.Force.Tolerance 1e-3
pdbSet Mechanics Convergence.Energy.Tolerance 1e-3

source_features.name: 力：submodel 技术
source_features.commands:
stressdata global.model=<c>
or
pdbSet Mechanics Submodel <c>

source_features.name: 力：液体表面张力
source_features.reference: p.122 Effective Surface Tension and Pressure due to Fluid

source_features.name: 力：追踪应力历史
source_features.reference: p.126 Automated Tracing of Stress History

source_features.name: 力：time step 控制
source_features.commands:
solve temperature=180.0<C> t.final=25.0<C> delNT=155.0 \
time=1.0<s> init=1.0<s> maxstep=1.0<s>

source_features.name: 力：计算主应力与主方向
source_features.commands:
pdbSet Mechanics Calculate.Principal.Stress 1
pdbSet Mechanics Calculate.Principal.Direction 1

source_features.name: 力：追踪最大应力
source_features.reference: p.14? Tracking Maximum Stress（页码被指针遮挡）

source_features.name: 热电耦合、焦耳热计算
source_features.commands:
pdbSet <material> Temperature JouleHeating 1
mode current thermal

source_features.name: 计算、打印 capacitance 矩阵
source_features.reference: p.749 Electrostatic Analysis: Capacitance Matrix; p.636 printCapacitanceMatrix; p.200 Capacitance Matrix

source_features.name: 计算、打印 resistance 矩阵
source_features.reference: p.757 Thermal Analysis: Thermal RC Network; p.640 printResistanceMatrix; p.193 Resistance Matrix

source_features.name: 计算、打印 thermal resistance 矩阵
source_features.reference: p.755 Thermal Analysis: Thermal Resistance Matrix; p.644 printThermalResistanceMatrix

source_features.name: 一维应力空间分布曲线
source_features.commands:
SetPlxList { StressEL_xx StressEL_yy StressEL_zz }
WritePlx n@node@_via.plx y=0.04 z=0.35 Copper

source_features.name: 沿空间方向提取数据，生成 .plx 文件
source_features.reference: p.391 Selecting Fields for Viewing or Analysis; p.392 Obtaining 1D Data Cuts; p.614 plot.1d

source_features.name: 变形可视化，支持变形系数
支持 total displacement 与 step displacement
source_features.commands:
pdbSet Mechanics Save.Displacement.Field 1
pdbSet Mechanics Save.Total.Displacement 1
pdbSet Mechanics Save.Step.Displacement 1

source_features.commands: 高斯点数据先内插为单元数据，然后按照单元数据的逻辑可视化

source_features.commands: StressGP、ElasticStrainGP 为力学分析的默认输出变量
source_features.reference: p.127 Fields defined on Gauss points

source_features.commands: 应变能密度为力学分析的默认输出变量

source_features.reference: p.261 UseLines and the transform Command

source_features.name: tcl 脚本支持 Shell 命令
迭代法求解器开放接口
source_features.commands:
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.method sts3
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.tolrel 1e-3
pdbSetDouble Math Flow ILS.refine.residual 1e-3
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.ilut.tau 1e-14
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.scaling diagsym
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.nonsymmOrdering none
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.refine.sts 1
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.leftPreconditioner 1
source_features.reference: p.400 Setting Parameters of the Iterative Solver ILS
